title: Synergistic effect of the low-carbon city and sci-tech finance pilots on green innovation in China
core_idea: This study investigates how dual-pilot policies—low-carbon city (LCC) and sci-tech finance city (STFC)—affect green innovation in Chinese cities. Using city-level data (278 cities, 2006–2021) and a multi-period DID framework, it examines impacts, underlying mechanisms (government technology funding, environmental regulation, venture capital agglomeration), sequencing effects, and heterogeneity across city size, region, and environmental foundation.
tldr: Analyzes whether and how LCC and STFC pilot policies jointly influence green innovation in China, the channels through which any effects operate, and variation by city characteristics, using 2006–2021 city data and a multi-period DID approach.
